reuse.why: Adds one shared check next to findOrCreateBank in accounts/link.ts and calls it from each linker; with no shared link flow in the tree, a call in each of the five copies is the natural reuse.

duplication.why: The rule itself is defined once; each site repeats the five-line call and recomputes the `orgDomain ?? orgId` bank key it already passes to findOrCreateBank.

placement.why: The check lives in accounts/link.ts beside the related bank lookup, and the handlers in accounts/app.ts only invoke it before any write.

scope.why: Only the check and its five call sites.

maintainability.why: A single definition is easy to change, but its extra bankId parameter (a join on banks) widens the identity of a linked account beyond provider + account id, and every new linker must remember to call it.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the per-site call.

one_place.where: accounts/link.ts ensureAccountIsNotLinked, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
